Student.title: Student
Student.description: Represents a student in the FinLit Classroom application.

points.description: The number of points the student has accumulated.

classRanking.description: The student's ranking within the class.

Reward.title: Reward
Reward.description: Represents a reward item available in the reward store.

id.description: Unique identifier for the reward item.

name.description: The name of the reward item.

description.description: A description of the reward item.

cost.description: The cost of the reward item in points.

imageUrl.description: URL of the image for the reward item.

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Represents a transaction of points, such as earning points or redeeming a reward.

amount.description: The amount of points involved in the transaction.

rewardId.description: Reference to Reward (optional). If the transaciton is reward redemption, the ID of the reward item. (Relationship: Reward 1:N Transaction)

Stock.title: Stock
Stock.description: Represents a stock available in the virtual stock market.

tickerSymbol.description: The ticker symbol of the stock (e.g., AAPL).

currentPrice.description: The current price of the stock.

Portfolio.title: Portfolio
Portfolio.description: Represents a student's virtual stock portfolio.

quantity.description: The number of shares of the stock held in the portfolio.

purchasePrice.description: The price at which the stock was purchased.

purchaseDate.description: The date the stock was purchased.

InterestRate.title: InterestRate
InterestRate.description: Stores the interest rate to be applied to student balances.

id.description: Unique identifier for the interest rate record.

effectiveDate.description: The date when this interest rate becomes effective.

definition.description: Stores student data. The studentId is a unique identifier for each student. This structure supports secure list operations.
Stores reward item data. The rewardId is a unique identifier for each reward. This structure supports secure list operations.
Stores transaction data. The transactionId is a unique identifier for each transaction. This structure supports secure list operations.
Stores stock data. The stockId is a unique identifier for each stock. This structure supports secure list operations.
Stores portfolio data. The portfolioId is a unique identifier for each portfolio. This structure supports secure list operations.
Stores interest rate data. The interestRateId is a unique identifier for each interest rate entry. This structure supports secure list operations.

params.description: Unique identifier for the interest rate record.

firestore.reasoning:
This Firestore data structure is designed for the FinLit Classroom application, prioritizing security, scalability, and ease of debugging, especially with the constraint of no cloud reads in security rules. It leverages structural segregation and denormalization to achieve authorization independence. Since there is no user information, only CRUD operations, there are no cloud reads required. Each entity has its own top-level collection with generated ids.

**Authorization Independence and QAPs:** Authorization Independence is achieved trivially since we are not reading data from the database in our rules. QAPs are supported because each collection represents a single security context, making `list` operations inherently secure. The absence of hierarchical dependencies further simplifies rule creation and maintenance.
